definitions.explanation: A flooded field used for growing rice. One of the most iconic elements of the Japanese rural landscape.

examples.english: To flood the rice field with water.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}になると、{田|た}に{稲|いね}を{植|う}える。
examples.english: When spring comes, we plant rice in the paddy.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}では、{田|た}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: Rice fields stretch out across this region.

notes:
READING VARIANTS:
- {田|た}: The standalone noun form
- {田んぼ|たんぼ}: Common informal variant meaning 'rice paddy'

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {水田|すいでん} (wet rice field)
- {田畑|たはた} (fields, rice paddies and dry fields)
- {田植え|たうえ} (rice planting)

CULTURAL NOTE: Rice paddies ({田|た}) are central to Japanese agriculture and culture. The character 田 appears in many family names (田中, 山田, 池田) and place names.
